title: Dealer-gamma regime intraday strategy on ES/NQ (Barbon & Buraschi 'Gamma Fragility'; Baltussen et al. hedging demand); intraday-flat (MFFU / Tradeify / Topstep compatible)
registered: 2026-10-20, BEFORE the SqueezeMetrics data exists in the repo
data: research_data/more2/squeeze_dix.csv (daily GEX, published after the close: day t uses the value of t-1); ES/NQ 1-minute 2018-26, NQ 1-minute 2010-17 (GEX starts 2011)
regime: low gamma = GEX(t-1) below its trailing 252-day 30th percentile; high gamma = above the 70th percentile

variants.LGM: low-gamma days only: momentum, sign of the 09:30 -> 10:00 return, held 10:00 -> 15:55
variants.BOTH: LGM plus high-gamma days: reversal, opposite sign of 09:30 -> 10:00, held 10:00 -> 15:55

sizing / costs: 0.5 per index; 2 x cost_frac per trade; same contract at both ends
